decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I narrowed down the products to those with high customer satisfaction (ratings above 4.5) and distinct use cases. The consideration set includes the ultra-portable EWA (192), the high-power DOSS SoundBox Pro+ (008), the mid-range NOTABRICK (168), the premium Sonos One SL (030), and the INSMY (128). I ultimately chose the INSMY Portable Bluetooth Speaker (128) because it offers a very strong value proposition: IPX7 waterproofing, 24-hour battery life, and high ratings (4.6) for a very affordable price of $29.99, making it the most versatile and low-risk purchase among the options.
